helpStorageRegression.assertionContract: Only the existing source chat tab may retain exactly its expected bounded text draft, SHA-256 role/owner/session fingerprint and timestamp. Help/recovery and localStorage retain their separate strict assertions; credentials, media, pending requests, history and extra wire fields are rejected.
